notes.title: Instant loading of jumps fixed
notes.notes: The game does not work correctly if vsync was disabled. The error was fixed thanks to Shilag for reporting it.

notes.title: The roll mechanic, camera movement and small changes
notes.notes:
[h2] Roll the ball [/h2]

If you hold the mouse pointer and rotate the ball in a circle, it will begin to roll in the direction you're rotating the mouse pointer. In short, you can roll the ball by making circles with the mouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481061/986acea094f0268da51e16a6b165cfb2e9864ba9.gif[/img]

[h2]Camera movement[/h2]

You can use the WASD keys to move the camera a little and see a little further ahead.

[h2]Cancel jump [/h2]

You can now cancel the jump with the right mouse button.

[h3] Small changes  [/h3]

- Fixed the bug where the gravel sound sometimes played twice.

- Jumps load a little faster now

- Possible improvement in game performance

notes.title: Change in sensitivity settings
notes.notes: Maximum mouse sensitivity has been increased.

notes.title: The gameplay is faster now
notes.notes:
This change is something the community has requested to make the game feel less sluggish. 

[b] - Gravity has been increased. Gameplay, like the ball's landing, is now faster.[/b]

notes.title: hot fix
notes.notes:
- A sound has been added when loading jumps.
- Some objects such as signs have been added to the map.
